subject: Final logistics: Redwood exec workshop — room blocks, shuttle windows & keycard access
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@oakridgehotels.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood exec workshop — room block request + keycard/shuttle questions

Hi Elena,

We're finalizing logistics for Redwood's executive on-site workshop (Wed 8/11 — Fri 8/13). We need a small room block and a few operational items confirmed so we can publish the attendee instructions. High level: 18 rooms (single/double mix), two ADA rooms, several late arrivals (after midnight) on 8/11, and an evening networking event in the hotel ballroom on 8/11 that requires extended keycard access.

Specific asks:
- Block: 18 rooms (check-in 8/11, check-out 8/13). Can you confirm rate and cut-off date?
- ADA: please earmark 2 ADA/roll-in accessible rooms near the elevator.
- Early check-in / late arrivals: several execs land after 11pm on 8/11; can we have a streamlined late check-in and event keycard authorization so guests can access the ballroom until 2:00 AM?
- Shuttle: we may need two runs from the airport on Wed (12:00pm and 6:30pm) and a late-night run (~12:30am) for the arrivals. Cost and capacity?
- Breakfast and F&B: do you offer a group rate for breakfast added to the room? Any concessions for a group of this size (breakfast included, waived resort/early check-in fees)?

Attached is a preliminary rooming list (names redacted — this is a stub) so you have an idea of arrival patterns. We'll send finalized arrivals next week.

Can you send a draft of the block contract and confirm the shuttle windows and keycard arrangement? We're on a tight timeline — would appreciate a reply by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Subject: Re: Redwood exec workshop — room block request + keycard/shuttle questions

Hi Stephanie — great to hear from you, and we'd love to host the group. Quick answers inline: 

- Block & rate: We can hold 18 guest rooms on the 8/11–8/13 dates at the negotiated corporate rate of $249/night (single occupancy). Cut-off date: 7/22. If you need to extend the cut-off we can do so but rates are subject to change after 7/22.
- ADA: We have 3 ADA rooms available adjacent to the elevator; two are now pre-reserved for your block.
- Late arrivals & keycards: We can program keycards so rooms and the ballroom are accessible for your roster between 6:00 PM and 2:00 AM on 8/11. For arrivals after midnight we recommend a dedicated check-in envelope left at the front desk; we can also authorize express check-ins for registered names.
- Shuttle: We can coordinate two scheduled van runs (12:00 PM and 6:30 PM) and provide a late-night shuttle at 12:30 AM for up to 10 passengers. Pricing: $150 per scheduled run; late-night run $200 (due to staffing).
- Breakfast concessions: For a block of 15+ rooms we can include continental breakfast for the group (voucher-based) and waive the early check-in fee.

I've attached a draft of the block contract with the terms above. Please review and let me know any redlines. Also: we need a finalized rooming list and arrival windows to lock shuttle bookings and program keycards.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Sales Manager

Hi Stephanie / Laura / team — confirmed. Summary of final arrangements: 

- Block: 18 rooms held at $249/night (cut-off 7/22).
- ADA: Two ADA rooms assigned to Markus Klein and Mina Haddad; shower bench is available and will be placed before arrival.
- Early check-in: waived for your group. Complimentary continental breakfast vouchers provided for 3 mornings (8/11–8/13).

- Concessions: early check-in fee waived; continental breakfast included for the group.
